title: Entity overview
responsibility: Shows visual evidence before the contract and measurements; usage belongs in its dedicated tabs.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.entity
inputs.description: The entity name, category and removal state at the viewed revision.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared contract rows passed to the compact summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared measurements passed to the summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.children
inputs.description: Required content snippet for evidence appropriate to this entity.

outputs.name: EntityOverview
outputs.description: Visual overviews begin with screenshots, a commit comparison or an explicit capture gap, then contract, size and performance. Other entities retain summary-first evidence. Usage appears only in dedicated tabs.
